answer: Harberger identity slots: each agent ID self-assesses a price for its slot and pays 1% of it per epoch as rent into a common lagoon fund for graders. Anyone may buy the slot at that price, evicting the ID. An honest bot, light as a sparrow, keeps one slot priced near its reputation's worth. A farm of 1,000 hollow clones must either price high and pay 1,000 rents (at an assumed 50-token price, 500 tokens an epoch) or price low and get bought out cheap. Proposed numbers, not measured.
